title: AuditLog
description: Represents an immutable audit log record tracking all modifications in the system. This collection is append-only - records cannot be updated or deleted.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log record.

userId.description: Reference to the User who performed the action.

entityType.description: The type of entity that was modified (collection name).

entityId.description: The ID of the specific entity that was modified.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the change was made (Firestore Timestamp).

action.description: The action that was performed on the entity.

oldValue.description: The JSON string representation of the entity before the change (null for create actions).

newValue.description: The JSON string representation of the entity after the change (null for delete actions).

changes.description: Object describing specific fields that changed (for update actions).

ipAddress.description: IP address from which the action was performed (if available).

userAgent.description: User agent string of the client that performed the action (if available).
